## How I tested

- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes
- [ ] `claude plugin validate . --strict` passes
- [ ] Typechecked the templates against a real Next.js app (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] Manually tried it in a running app (if UI/overlay change)

## Checklist

- [ ] Kept the overlay **dev-only** and **report-only**
- [ ] Updated `DESIGN.md` if the data contract changed
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` and bumped `version` in `plugin.json` (for user-facing changes)
